svg.title: It uses real symmetry of Π and the almost-everywhere transverse constraint. Repetition over the finite slots and finite labels preserves all other factors. A single chosen component per test therefore selects the indicated label sector exactly. Together with b ̄g+ = bg−, this recovers the source’s isolated two-frequency formula. The already paid shrinking real trace bump yields TR32 with the same domination. Thus the coherent-extraction dependency in the locality-to-dilation argument is recovered without imposing regular representatives of the waves.
